name: Artifacts
description: Pages that run. Attach it to any app, and its agent can show you a single page it writes — a calculator, a form, a little tool — right in the conversation, where the page's own script answers your clicks. A page reaches no network, and it never reaches the model.

tools.name: show
tools.title: Show a page you wrote
tools.description: Show the person a page you write: one whole HTML document with its scripts and styles inline, such as a calculator, a form or a small tool. It shows under this call, where its own script answers the person's clicks, and the person can open it in a tab. It reaches no network, so it loads nothing by address: no script, style, font or picture from elsewhere. It cannot send you anything and you do not see it, so put everything it needs into html. To change the page, call this again with the whole new page.

title.description: A few words naming the page, as the person reads them

html.description: The whole page: one HTML document with its scripts and styles inline
